item.title: “She’s A Bad Mama Jama” Singer Carl Carlton Dead At 73
item.description: Carl Carlton, the R&B singer best known for 1974's top 10 single "Everlasting Love" and the Grammy-winning 1981 hit "She's A Bad Mama Jama (She's Built, She's Stacked)," has died. His son, Carlton Hudgens II, announced his death in a Facebook post Sunday: "RIP Dad, Legend Carl Carlton singer of She's a Bad Mama Jama. Long hard fight in life and you will be missed."
